Title: Butter chicken perfection
Review: The butter chicken was velvety and mildly sweet with tender chicken. The garlic naan was soft and blistered exactly right.

Title: Huge vegetarian menu
Review: As a vegetarian I could order almost anything. The paneer tikka, chana masala and baingan bharta were all excellent. Many dishes are marked vegan.

Title: Slow on weekends
Review: We waited 35 minutes for starters on Saturday. The kitchen was clearly overwhelmed and nobody updated us.

Title: Spice level honest
Review: When I asked for hot they actually made it hot. The lamb vindaloo had a proper kick. Ask for medium if you are not used to spice.

Title: Mild for my taste
Review: I ordered medium and found everything fairly mild. The flavors were good but lacked depth.

Title: Lovely lunch buffet
Review: Weekday buffet has about ten dishes, fresh naan and a dessert. Great value for 14 dollars, though the tandoori items dry out.

Title: Biryani was dry
Review: The chicken biryani was dry and the rice clumped together. The raita helped, but I expected better.

Title: Warm hospitality
Review: The owner came to our table, explained regional dishes, and brought a free mango lassi for the kids. We felt like guests.

Title: Gluten free options
Review: Most curries are gluten free and the staff marked which ones. Rice and dal are safe, just skip the naan and samosas.

Title: Family friendly
Review: High chairs available, a roomy booth for our stroller and mild dishes for toddlers. Staff were patient with our noisy table.

Title: Pricey drinks
Review: Food prices are fair but soft drinks and lassis cost 6 dollars each. Drinks pushed up the bill.

Title: Fantastic samosa chaat
Review: Crunchy samosas topped with chickpeas, yogurt and tamarind chutney. Best starter I have had in years.

Title: Wrong order
Review: They brought lamb instead of chicken and when we pointed it out the server seemed annoyed. The replacement was good but the attitude was not.

Title: Delivery arrived cold
Review: Delivery took 70 minutes and the curries were lukewarm. The naan had turned chewy in the bag.

Title: Great for large groups
Review: We had a party of 12 with a reservation. They seated us promptly and offered a shared platter menu that made ordering easy.

Title: Clean and cozy
Review: Warm colors, soft music and spotless tables. Nice atmosphere for a quiet dinner.

Title: Excellent dal makhani
Review: The dal makhani tasted slow cooked and smoky. Easily the best dish of the night, and it is vegetarian.

Title: Allergy handled well
Review: I explained my tree nut allergy and the chef came out to confirm which sauces contain cashew. Very responsible, and the korma was made safely.

Title: Tiny portions
Review: Curry portions were small for the price. We needed to order extra rice and naan to feel full.

Title: Fast takeaway
Review: Pickup order was ready in 12 minutes, well packed with the sauces in separate containers.

Title: Fresh tandoori
Review: Tandoori chicken was juicy with real smoke from the clay oven. Served with fresh mint chutney.

Title: Noisy dining room
Review: Hard floors and no sound absorption means it echoes when full. Food great but hard to talk.

Title: Dessert highlight
Review: The gulab jamun was warm and not too sweet and the kulfi tasted of real pistachio.

Title: Parking is tricky
Review: No dedicated lot. Street parking fills quickly after 6 PM, so allow extra time.

Title: Attentive server
Review: Our server suggested pairing dishes and checked on spice levels twice. Water and chai were always topped up.

Title: Disappointing korma
Review: The chicken korma was oily and the sauce split. It tasted like it had been sitting in a warmer.

Title: Hygiene concern
Review: Our table had sticky residue and the water glasses had spots. Staff wiped it when asked but it made me uneasy.
